cs.t: Foscam  http://foscam.us  Years ago my extended family bought one to monitor a remote camp.  I created a little PHP script that would grab the latest images uploaded via FTP and make a photo gallery.  Set up was difficult but it worked reliably.  They have a Ring now ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
cs.th: Amazon Ring’s neighborhood watch app is making police requests public
